# Live harness captures

Only frames written by a real, installed harness during a run the user explicitly authorized go here, one JSONL file
per capture. Nothing in this folder is generated by a test, and nothing here was recorded in the R0501 task: the
Claude Code hook-callback capture gate is pending (see `../provenance.json` and
`docs/extensions/runtime-hook-fixtures.md`).

A capture file starts with a header line
`{"_fixture":{"provenance":"harness-capture","liveCapture":true,"harness":...,"capturedAt":...,"harnessVersion":...,"authorization":...}}`
and is listed in `../provenance.json` with `capture.form: "live"` and the same authorization. A synthetic or
SDK-derived file moved or relabelled into this folder fails `runtime_hook_fixtures::validate`.
